### Views (10)

| View | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `v_active_role_permission` | v | `SELECT aur.user_id, aur.user_role_assignment_id AS source_assignment_id, aur.role_id, aur.role_code, aur.scope_type, CASE aur.scope_type WHEN 'GLOBAL'::text THEN 0::bigint WHEN 'INSTITUTION'::text THEN aur.institution_id::bigint WHEN 'CAMPUS'::text THEN aur.campus_id::bigint WHEN 'DEPARTMENT'::text THEN aur.department_id::bigint WHEN 'PROGRAMME'::text THEN aur.programme_id::bigint WHEN 'SELF'::text THEN aur.user_id::bigint ELSE NULL::bigint END AS scope_entity_id, p.permission_id, p.permission_code, rp.permission_effect, 'DIRECT'::text AS permission_source FROM v_active_user_role aur JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id::integer = aur.role_id::integer JOIN permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id::bigint WHERE p.is_active = true UNION ALL SELECT rd.delegate_user_id AS user_id, aur.user_role_assignment_id AS source_assignment_id, aur.role_id, aur.role_code, aur.scope_type, CASE aur.scope_type WHEN 'GLOBAL'::text THEN 0::bigint WHEN 'INSTITUTION'::text THEN aur.institution_id::bigint WHEN 'CAMPUS'::text THEN aur.campus_id::bigint WHEN 'DEPARTMENT'::text THEN aur.department_id::bigint WHEN 'PROGRAMME'::text THEN aur.programme_id::bigint WHEN 'SELF'::text THEN rd.delegate_user_id::bigint ELSE NULL::bigint END AS scope_entity_id, p.permission_id, p.permission_code, rp.permission_effect, 'DELEGATED'::text AS permission_source FROM role_delegation rd JOIN v_active_user_role aur ON aur.user_role_assignment_id = rd.source_assignment_id::bigint JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id::integer = aur.role_id::integer JOIN permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id::bigint WHERE rd.delegation_status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND rd.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND rd.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND p.is_active = true;` |
| `v_active_user_role` | v | `SELECT ura.user_role_assignment_id, ura.user_id, ura.role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, ura.scope_type, ura.institution_id, ura.campus_id, ura.department_id, ura.programme_id, ura.valid_from, ura.valid_to FROM user_role_assignment ura JOIN role r ON r.role_id = ura.role_id::integer WHERE ura.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND r.is_active = true AND ura.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (ura.valid_to IS NULL OR ura.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);` |
| `v_effective_user_permission` | v | `SELECT user_id, permission_id, permission_code, scope_type, scope_entity_id, CASE WHEN max(is_deny) = 1 THEN 'DENY'::text ELSE 'ALLOW'::text END AS permission_effect FROM ( SELECT arp.user_id, arp.permission_id, arp.permission_code, arp.scope_type, arp.scope_entity_id, CASE WHEN arp.permission_effect = 'DENY'::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_deny FROM v_active_role_permission arp UNION ALL SELECT upo.user_id, upo.permission_id, p.permission_code, upo.scope_type, CASE WHEN upo.scope_type = ANY (ARRAY['GLOBAL'::text, 'SELF'::text]) THEN 0::bigint ELSE upo.scope_entity_id::bigint END AS scope_entity_id, CASE WHEN upo.permission_effect = 'DENY'::text THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_deny FROM user_permission_override upo JOIN permission p ON p.permission_id = upo.permission_id::bigint WHERE p.is_active = true AND upo.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (upo.valid_to IS NULL OR upo.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) x GROUP BY user_id, permission_id, permission_code, scope_type, scope_entity_id;` |
| `v_employee_previous_experience` | v | `SELECT epe.employee_previous_employment_id, epe.employee_id, po.organization_name, epe.designation, epe.employment_type, epe.employment_start_date, epe.employment_end_date, COALESCE(epe.experience_days::bigint, (COALESCE(epe.employment_end_date, CURRENT_DATE) - epe.employment_start_date + 1)::bigint) AS calculated_experience_days, EXTRACT(year FROM age(COALESCE(epe.employment_end_date, CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, epe.employment_start_date::timestamp with time zone))::integer AS completed_years, mod((EXTRACT(year FROM age(COALESCE(epe.employment_end_date, CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, epe.employment_start_date::timestamp with time zone)) * 12::numeric + EXTRACT(month FROM age(COALESCE(epe.employment_end_date, CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, epe.employment_start_date::timestamp with time zone)))::integer, 12) AS remaining_months FROM employee_previous_employment epe JOIN previous_organization po ON po.previous_organization_id = epe.previous_organization_id::bigint WHERE epe.deleted_at IS NULL;` |
| `v_fee_collection_summary` | v | `SELECT pt.transaction_date::date AS collection_date, pm.mode_code, count(*) AS transaction_count, sum(pt.amount) AS collected_amount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN payment_mode pm ON pm.payment_mode_id = pt.payment_mode_id::smallint WHERE pt.payment_status = 'SUCCESS'::text GROUP BY (pt.transaction_date::date), pm.mode_code;` |
| `v_staff_activity_profile` | v | `SELECT sa.staff_activity_id, sa.employee_id, e.employee_number, e.display_name AS staff_name, at.activity_type_code, at.activity_type_name, at.activity_group, sa.activity_title, ay.year_code AS academic_year, u.university_name, i.institution_name, c.campus_name, d.department_name, pl.level_name AS participation_level, rt.role_name AS primary_role, sa.start_date, sa.end_date, vs.status_name AS verification_status, aps.status_name AS approval_status, sa.created_at, sa.updated_at, sa.deleted_at FROM staff_activity sa JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = sa.employee_id::bigint JOIN activity_type at ON at.activity_type_id = sa.activity_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN academic_year ay ON ay.academic_year_id = sa.academic_year_id::integer JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = sa.institution_id::integer JOIN university u ON u.university_id = i.university_id::integer LEFT JOIN campus c ON c.campus_id = sa.campus_id::integer LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = sa.department_id::integer LEFT JOIN participation_level pl ON pl.participation_level_id = sa.participation_level_id::smallint LEFT JOIN role_type rt ON rt.role_type_id = sa.primary_role_type_id::integer JOIN verification_status vs ON vs.verification_status_id = sa.verification_status_id::smallint JOIN approval_status aps ON aps.approval_status_id = sa.approval_status_id::smallint;` |
| `v_staff_evidence_search` | v | `SELECT ed.evidence_document_id, ed.staff_activity_id, sa.employee_id, e.employee_number, e.display_name AS staff_name, d.department_id, d.department_name, at.activity_type_code, at.activity_type_name, ay.year_code AS academic_year, dt.document_code, dt.document_name, et.evidence_type_code, et.evidence_type_name, ed.document_title, ed.certificate_document_number, ed.document_issue_date, ed.expiry_date, vs.status_name AS verification_status, aps.status_name AS approval_status, cl.level_name AS confidentiality_level, ed.current_version_number, ed.is_active, ed.created_at, ed.updated_at, ed.deleted_at FROM evidence_document ed JOIN staff_activity sa ON sa.staff_activity_id = ed.staff_activity_id::bigint JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = sa.employee_id::bigint JOIN activity_type at ON at.activity_type_id = sa.activity_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN academic_year ay ON ay.academic_year_id = ed.academic_year_id::integer LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = sa.department_id::integer JOIN document_type dt ON dt.document_type_id = ed.document_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN evidence_type et ON et.evidence_type_id = ed.evidence_type_id::integer JOIN verification_status vs ON vs.verification_status_id = ed.verification_status_id::smallint JOIN approval_status aps ON aps.approval_status_id = ed.approval_status_id::smallint JOIN confidentiality_level cl ON cl.confidentiality_level_id = ed.confidentiality_level_id::smallint;` |
| `v_student_activity_evidence_search` | v | `SELECT sae.student_activity_evidence_id, sae.student_activity_id, sa.student_id, s.student_number, s.display_name AS student_name, sat.type_code AS activity_type_code, sat.type_name AS activity_type_name, d.department_id, d.department_name, p.programme_id, p.programme_name, ay.year_code AS academic_year, dt.document_code, dt.document_name, et.evidence_type_code, et.evidence_type_name, sae.document_title, sae.certificate_document_number, sae.document_issue_date, sae.expiry_date, vs.status_name AS verification_status, aps.status_name AS approval_status, cl.level_name AS confidentiality_level, sae.current_version_number, sae.is_active, sae.created_at, sae.updated_at, sae.deleted_at FROM student_activity_evidence sae JOIN student_activity sa ON sa.student_activity_id = sae.student_activity_id::bigint JOIN student s ON s.student_id = sa.student_id::bigint JOIN student_activity_type sat ON sat.student_activity_type_id = sa.student_activity_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN academic_year ay ON ay.academic_year_id = sae.academic_year_id::integer LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = sa.department_id::integer LEFT JOIN programme p ON p.programme_id = sa.programme_id::integer JOIN document_type dt ON dt.document_type_id = sae.document_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN evidence_type et ON et.evidence_type_id = sae.evidence_type_id::integer JOIN verification_status vs ON vs.verification_status_id = sae.verification_status_id::smallint JOIN approval_status aps ON aps.approval_status_id = sae.approval_status_id::smallint JOIN confidentiality_level cl ON cl.confidentiality_level_id = sae.confidentiality_level_id::smallint;` |
| `v_student_activity_profile` | v | `SELECT sa.student_activity_id, sa.student_id, s.student_number, s.display_name AS student_name, sat.type_code AS activity_type_code, sat.type_name AS activity_type_name, sat.activity_group, sa.activity_title, sa.event_name, ay.year_code AS academic_year, i.institution_name, c.campus_name, d.department_name, p.programme_name, pl.level_name AS participation_level, em.mode_name AS event_mode, sa.start_date, sa.end_date, sa.achievement_type, sa.position_rank, sa.award_name, sa.cash_prize_amount, vs.status_name AS verification_status, aps.status_name AS approval_status, sa.created_at, sa.updated_at, sa.deleted_at FROM student_activity sa JOIN student s ON s.student_id = sa.student_id::bigint JOIN student_activity_type sat ON sat.student_activity_type_id = sa.student_activity_type_id::integer LEFT JOIN academic_year ay ON ay.academic_year_id = sa.academic_year_id::integer JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = sa.institution_id::integer LEFT JOIN campus c ON c.campus_id = sa.campus_id::integer LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = sa.department_id::integer LEFT JOIN programme p ON p.programme_id = sa.programme_id::integer LEFT JOIN participation_level pl ON pl.participation_level_id = sa.participation_level_id::smallint LEFT JOIN event_mode em ON em.event_mode_id = sa.event_mode_id::smallint JOIN verification_status vs ON vs.verification_status_id = sa.verification_status_id::smallint JOIN approval_status aps ON aps.approval_status_id = sa.approval_status_id::smallint;` |
| `v_student_fee_balance` | v | `SELECT sfa.student_account_id, sfa.student_id, sfa.account_number, COALESCE(sum(sfa2.net_payable_amount), 0.00) AS total_assessed, COALESCE(sum(sfa2.amount_paid), 0.00) AS total_paid, COALESCE(sum(sfa2.balance_amount), 0.00) AS total_outstanding, sfa.credit_balance FROM student_financial_account sfa LEFT JOIN student_fee_assessment sfa2 ON sfa2.student_account_id::bigint = sfa.student_account_id AND (sfa2.assessment_status <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'WAIVED'::text])) GROUP BY sfa.student_account_id, sfa.student_id, sfa.account_number, sfa.credit_balance;` |
